//: THE REVIEWER deployment (FastAPI). This repo ships two separate Vercel
reviewer  -> Root Directory: <repo root>  -> this file
Both projects point at the same Git repo; they differ only by Root
Directory, which is what makes each pick up its own config.
The entrypoint itself is declared in pyproject.toml under
[tool.vercel] -- Vercel's Python runtime reads it from there, which is
what the 'No FastAPI entrypoint found' error was asking for. It points
at reviewer/vercel_app.py, a thin shim around the untouched
buildCommand here takes precedence over [tool.vercel.scripts] build;
it is set in both places so a `vercel build` run from either config
